beta.notes:
New in this version:
• When AI is unavailable, Work Sample Buddy explains why and offers to start Ollama, open AI settings, or turn AI off.

Fixes:
• Restoring AI now retries interrupted grading once, including work waiting for Resume, while preserving teacher edits and newer submission revisions.
• Fixed repeated AI outage prompts after recovery and unnecessary AI checks in Simple Mode or when AI is turned off.
• Page orientation checks can use built-in Windows OCR when RapidOCR is unavailable, and leave pages unchanged when results are uncertain.

stable.notes:
New in this version:
• Missing Schoology work now offers a direct assignment link and a Reload action in the center of the viewer.
• Reload checks Schoology again and downloads newly submitted work automatically.

Fixes:
• Fixed course-card clicks opening a different student's course or assignment. The selected student and course now stay together through grading.
• Fixed missing-assignment links sending signed-in teachers to the generic Schoology login page.
